name: cro-roi-calculator
description: Calculates the monthly and annual revenue impact of a conversion rate improvement. Takes current traffic, CVR, AOV, and a target improvement percentage, and returns incremental revenue, new CVR, and extra conversions per month.

currentCVR.description: Current conversion rate as a percentage

aov.description: Average order or lead value in EUR

cvrImprovementPct.description: Target relative CVR improvement as a percentage (e.g. 25 for +25%)
